Lumenwise Privacy Policy

Effective November 18, 2026 (version 1.0) · Last updated November 18, 2026

The short version. Your highlights, notes, prayers and questions are stored on your iPhone. There is no account and we run no server, so we never have your data. The Bible texts are built into the app, and Ask is answered by Apple's on-device AI, so your questions never leave your phone. Purchases go through Apple. There are no ads and no tracking.

Who we are

Lumenwise is made by an independent developer ("we", "us"). This policy covers the Lumenwise iPhone app, its widgets and its Siri and Shortcuts actions. Lumenwise is not affiliated with any church, denomination or Bible publisher. Questions: SUPPORT_EMAIL_TBD.

Your data stays on your device

What you create in Lumenwise is stored in a database in the app's own private storage on your iPhone:

  • highlights, verse notes and bookmarks;
  • the reading plans you join, your progress and daily reading logs (used to count your streak);
  • prayer requests, the updates you add to them and notes on answered prayers;
  • your Ask conversations (the questions you type and the answers shown).

Your preferences are kept in the app's settings on the device: your Bible translation, reader settings (such as font, size and theme), the faith tradition you pick for Ask, your reminder time, whether the prayer journal is locked, and a cached note of whether Pro is active.

There is no iCloud sync in this version. Nothing syncs or leaves your iPhone except what you explicitly share or export. We have no server for this data and cannot see it. Like any app's data, it is included in your own device backups (iCloud Backup or a computer backup), which Apple and you control.

Ask: AI on your iPhone

  • Ask uses Apple's on-device Foundation Models, which run entirely on your iPhone. It is available on iOS 26 or later, on devices that support Apple Intelligence with Apple Intelligence turned on.
  • Your questions and the answers are never sent to us or to any third party. There is no cloud AI service and no proxy server, and Ask works in Airplane Mode.
  • Answers can only quote Bible verses that the app looks up in its built-in text, word for word (our "Verbatim-Verse Guarantee"). The explanations around those verses are generated by the on-device model and can be wrong; see the Terms of Use.
  • On devices without Apple Intelligence, Lumenwise shows study notes that are built into the app instead. Nothing is sent anywhere.
  • Your Ask history is saved on your iPhone so you can come back to it, and you can delete it at any time.

Bible texts and search

The King James Version (1769 text) and the World English Bible are built into the app, so reading works offline. Both are public domain texts from eBible.org. Searching the Bible happens on your iPhone using a local index. No network connection is used for scripture or search, and we never learn what you read or search for.

Widgets and Siri

To show widgets, Lumenwise copies a small summary into a storage area shared only with its own widgets (an App Group): the verse of the day for the next few days, the title and progress of your current reading plan, your current and longest streak and whether you read today, up to 30 of your highlighted verses (for the My Highlights widget), prayer counts (how many you are praying about, how many were answered this year and your last check-in), and items for the prayer check-in widget.

  • Prayer titles appear on widgets only if you turn on "show prayer titles on widgets", which is off by default. Widgets can be seen on your Home Screen and Lock Screen, so think about who can see your phone before turning this on.
  • When you answer a prayer check-in from the interactive widget, the answer is queued in the same shared area. The app applies it to your journal the next time it opens and then clears the queue.
  • Siri and Shortcuts actions (verse of the day, prayer check-ins, open today's reading, add a prayer, ask about a verse) use this local summary or open the app. Prayer titles are spoken only if you show them on widgets and the journal is not locked. Links into the app use Lumenwise's own link scheme and stay on your device.

Things you choose to share

Lumenwise never sends anything on its own. These features only share what you choose, through iOS's share sheet or the Photos app:

  • Verse cards: an image of a verse you design, shared or saved to Photos by you.
  • Sharing a verse or your plan progress, including "read together" invites for a reading plan, sent by you to someone you choose.
  • Exports of notes, highlights or your prayer journal (PDF or text). Keep these files somewhere safe; a prayer journal export contains your personal prayers.

Once you share something, the app or person you send it to handles it under their own privacy practices.

Permissions

All permissions are optional. Lumenwise works without them.

  • Notifications: a daily reading reminder, prayer check-back reminders with "Answered" and "Still praying" buttons, and a reminder about 2 days before a free trial turns into a paid subscription. All are scheduled locally on your iPhone; no notification server is used. Prayer check-back reminders show the prayer's title on the Lock Screen and in Notification Center unless the prayer journal lock is on; the "show prayer titles on widgets" switch does not change them.
  • Face ID, Touch ID or passcode to lock the prayer journal. This is handled entirely by iOS. Lumenwise only learns whether unlocking succeeded and never receives biometric data.
  • Photos. To save verse cards to your library (add-only). If you pick a photo as a verse-card background, Lumenwise reads that one photo on your iPhone, uses it only to draw the card and never uploads it.
  • Background audio: lets read-aloud keep playing when you lock your phone. Read-aloud uses Apple's on-device speech voices; the text is not sent anywhere.

Lumenwise does not ask for your location, contacts, camera, microphone or Health data.

Network connections

Lumenwise works offline. It connects to the internet only for Apple's App Store (prices, purchases, restores and subscription status) and for links you tap. Scripture, search, Ask and read-aloud never use the network. You can check this yourself in iOS's App Privacy Report (Settings > Privacy & Security > App Privacy Report).

Purchases and subscriptions

Lumenwise Pro is sold through Apple's App Store using StoreKit. Apple handles the payment, your payment details, your Apple ID and your billing address. We never see your name, email address or payment information. The app only receives a signed confirmation from Apple saying which product is active (for example, "Yearly, renews on a date" or "Lifetime") so it can unlock Pro. That check happens on your device. Apple's handling of purchase data is covered by Apple's Privacy Policy.

App Store Connect gives us aggregated, non-identifying sales reports (for example, how many trials started in a country). Apple does not give us your identity.

Lumenwise Pro is offered as Lumenwise Pro Yearly (an auto-renewing yearly subscription with a 7-day free trial for eligible new subscribers) and Lumenwise Pro Lifetime (a one-time purchase). Both support Family Sharing. You can restore purchases and manage your subscription from the app's Settings.

No ads and no tracking

This version of Lumenwise has no ads. It includes no advertising, analytics or tracking SDK, it never asks for permission to track you across other companies' apps and websites, and nothing you do in Lumenwise is used for advertising, by us or by anyone else. Lumenwise is paid for only by Lumenwise Pro, the optional yearly subscription and lifetime purchase.

If a future version adds advertising, we will update this policy, its changelog and the App Store privacy label before that version is released, and the app will ask for your permission where the law or Apple requires it.

Religious beliefs and sensitive information

What you read, highlight, pray about and ask can reveal religious or philosophical beliefs, which many privacy laws treat as sensitive. That is why it never leaves your control: it stays on your iPhone, it is not sent to us, it is not shared with anyone else, and it is not used for advertising, profiling or research. The faith tradition you pick for Ask only changes how answers are worded on your device.

What we never do

  • No account, sign-in or email address needed.
  • No server holding your data, no cloud AI, no ads, and no advertising, analytics, tracking or crash-reporting SDKs.
  • We never sell your data and never use your reading, notes, prayers or questions for advertising.
  • This version of Lumenwise does not use iCloud or CloudKit, Apple Health or Spotlight indexing.

Data retention

  • On-device data is kept until you delete it (individual items, deleting all data in Settings, or deleting the app). We keep no copy.
  • Purchase records are kept by Apple under Apple's policies.
  • Support emails are kept only as long as needed to help you and keep a record of the conversation, then deleted, normally within 24 months. Ask us to delete them sooner at any time.

Exporting and deleting your data

  • Export: you can export your prayer journal, and with Pro your notes and highlights, as PDF or text.
  • Delete single items: highlights, notes, bookmarks, prayers and Ask conversations can each be deleted where they are listed.
  • Delete everything: the Privacy section of Lumenwise Settings has an option to delete all your data, with a confirmation. It erases your highlights, notes, bookmarks, prayers, plans, Ask history, reminders and widget content on this iPhone and can't be undone. Display and Ask preferences (such as translation, font, the faith tradition and tone you picked for Ask) and the daily Ask question counter are kept until you change them or delete the app.
  • Deleting the app removes all its on-device data, including the widget summary. It does not cancel a subscription.

Your privacy rights

Because Lumenwise has no account, no server and no ads, we do not hold a profile about you. Your app data is on your device. You can view, export (where the app offers it) and delete it yourself. Whatever your location, you can email us and we will help.

EEA, UK and Switzerland (GDPR / UK GDPR)

  • Who is responsible. We, the developer of Lumenwise, are the controller for the limited personal data we handle, which in practice means emails you send us. What you keep in the app stays on your device; we never receive it.
  • Legal bases. Replying to your support email: our legitimate interest in helping you (or steps you ask for before a contract). Purchases: handled by Apple under Apple's terms.
  • Your rights. Access, correction, deletion, restriction, objection and data portability, and, where processing is based on your consent, withdrawing it at any time without affecting earlier processing. Ask about any of them by emailing SUPPORT_EMAIL_TBD.
  • Complaints. You can complain to your local data protection authority. We would appreciate the chance to fix things first.
  • International transfers. Your app data is not transferred anywhere, because it never leaves your device. If you email us, your message is stored by the email service we use, which may be located outside your country.

California and other US states (CCPA / CPRA and similar laws)

  • What we collect. The app itself collects no personal information: what you enter stays on your device, is never sent to us, and there is no advertising, analytics or tracking SDK. If you email us, we receive your email address and what you write. We use it only to reply.
  • No selling or sharing. We never sell personal information and never share it for cross-context behavioral advertising. We do not use or disclose sensitive personal information.
  • Your rights. To know/access, delete and correct the personal information we hold (in practice, your emails to us). We will not discriminate against you for using these rights. An authorized agent may make a request on your behalf with your written permission.
  • Retention. See Data retention.

Residents of other US states with consumer privacy laws (for example Virginia, Colorado, Connecticut, Utah, Texas and Oregon) have similar rights. Email us to use them. If we decline a request, you can appeal by replying to our answer with "Appeal" in the subject line.

Children

Lumenwise is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13 (or the minimum age in your country). If you believe a child has provided personal information to us, for example by email, contact us and we will delete it.

Security

Your data is protected by iOS app sandboxing and Data Protection encryption, and you can lock the prayer journal with Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode. Because we don't operate a server, there is no developer-held database of your notes, prayers or questions that could be breached. Keep your device passcode, your Apple ID and any exported files secure.

Contact

Email SUPPORT_EMAIL_TBD for questions, privacy requests or complaints. If you email us, we receive your email address and what you write. We use it only to reply; please don't include prayer details or other personal information we don't need. We usually reply within 2 business days and always within 7 days, and answer privacy requests within the time the law requires (30 days under GDPR, 45 days under CCPA).

Changes and changelog

If we change how Lumenwise handles data, for example if we add iCloud sync, we will update this page and the date at the top before the change takes effect, and for significant changes we will tell you in the app. The App Store privacy label is kept in line with this page.
